titre: Control Test n°1 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Hello! My name is Sami. I am eleven years old. I live in Tunis with my family. I have short black hair and brown eyes. My best friend is Karim. He is tall and funny. We are in the sixth year. Our school is big and clean. I like Maths and English. Classes start at eight o'clock.

Answer the questions:
1) How old is Sami? (1 pt)
2) Where does Sami live? (1 pt)
3) What does Karim look like? (1 pt)
4) What subjects does Sami like? (1 pt)

Complete with: am / is / are
1) I ...... a pupil.
2) Karim ...... tall.
3) We ...... in the sixth year.
4) The school ...... big.

Match each word with its opposite:
1) tall     a) dirty
2) big      b) short
3) clean    c) sad
4) funny... write: happy? — Match:
1) tall - ......  2) big - ......  3) clean - ......  4) short (opposite of) - ......
(a) dirty  (b) short  (c) small  (d) tall

Put the words in the right order:
1) name / is / My / Sami / . 
2) old / I / eleven / am / years / . 
3) English / like / I / .

Writing:
Write 3 to 4 sentences about yourself (your name, age, where you live, your best friend).

Grammar: possessive 's.
Rewrite using 's.
1) the name of Sami -> ..........
2) the school of Karim -> ..........
3) the hair of my friend -> ..........
